                if million > 0 then under1000(million) + " Million" else "",

            local queryExcludedOptions = _calc.getGlobalExcludedOptions(target, rules);
            local queryAssociatedOptions = _calc.getGlobalAssociatedOptions(target, rules);

            // List of side effects:
            // A: if field is disabled by parent or blocked: if invisible widget then [hide] else [disable]
            // B: if field is disabled by rule, parent or blocked, [clear] value and backup value
            // C: if selected option is disabled, [clear] the options
            // D: [multiple value] apply exclude logic on [value]
            // E: [fakeCheckbox] apply associate logic on [value]
            // F1: [single value] if fill and disable, [disable]
            // F2: [multiple value] if fill and disable, [disabledOptions] which are exclusive or associated with pre-checked options
            // H: [multiple value] [disabledOptions] when its exclusive options are checked
            // I: if all options are disabled, [disable]
            // K: [option widgets] [value] ignored invalid pre-filled options

            local commands =
                res.commands
                .andThen(
                    function(cmds)
                        std.foldl(
                            function(acc, rule)
                                if rule.typ == _rule.typ.hide.key || rule.typ == _rule.typ.show.key then
                                    _calc.combineHideRule(acc, rule)

                                else if rule.typ == _rule.typ.blockForm.key then
                                    _calc.combineBlockFormRule(acc, rule, target)

                                else
                                    acc
                            , rules
                            , cmds
                        )
                )
                .andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectA(target))
                .andThen(
                    function(cmds)
                        local isGlobalHidden = cmds.store.isGlobalHidden;

                        if isGlobalHidden then
                            cmds
                        else
                            cmds
                            .andThen(
                                function(cmds)
                                    std.foldl(
                                        function(acc, rule)
                                            if rule.typ == _rule.typ.deactivate.key || rule.typ == _rule.typ.activate.key then
                                                _calc.combineDisableRule(acc, rule)

                                            else
                                                acc
                                        , rules
                                        , cmds
                                    )
                            )
                            .andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectB(target))
                            .andThen(
                                function(cmds)
                                    local isGlobalDeactivated = cmds.store.isGlobalDeactivated;

                                    if isGlobalDeactivated then
                                        cmds.andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectV(target))
                                    else
                                        cmds
                                        .andThen(
                                            function(cmds)
                                                std.foldl(
                                                    function(acc, rule)
                                                        if rule.typ == _rule.typ.unsafeSetValue.key then
                                                            _calc.combineSetPropertyValueRule(acc, rule)

                                                        else if rule.typ == _rule.typ.unsafeDeselectOptions.key then
                                                            _calc.combineDeselectOptionsRule(target, acc, rule)

                                                        else
                                                            acc
                                                    , rules
                                                    , cmds
                                                )
                                        )
                                        .andThen(
                                            function(cmds)
                                                std.foldl(
                                                    function(acc, rule)
                                                        if rule.typ == _rule.typ.deactivateOptions.key || rule.typ == _rule.typ.activateOptions.key then
                                                            _calc.combineDisabledOptionsRule(target, acc, rule)

                                                        else if rule.typ == _rule.typ.setWarning.key then
                                                            _calc.combineWarningRule(acc, rule)

                                                        else if rule.typ == _rule.typ.setError.key then
                                                            _calc.combineSetErrorRule(acc, rule)

                                                        else if rule.typ == _rule.typ.enableFiles.key || rule.typ == _rule.typ.enableAllFiles.key then
                                                            _calc.combineEnableFilesRule(target, acc, rule)

                                                        else if rule.typ == _rule.typ.setSigningTypes.key then
                                                            _calc.combineSigningTypesRule(acc, rule)

                                                        else
                                                            acc
                                                    , rules
                                                    , cmds
                                                )
                                        )
                                        .andThen(
                                            function(cmds)
                                                std.foldl(
                                                    function(acc, rule)
                                                        if rule.typ == _rule.typ.addDeactivatedOptions.key
                                                           || rule.typ == _rule.typ.addActivatedOptions.key then
                                                            _calc.combineAddDisabledOptionsRule(acc, rule)

                                                        else
                                                            acc
                                                    , rules
                                                    , cmds
                                                )
                                        )
                                        .andThen(
                                            function(cmds)
                                                local isDisabled = _calc.getDisabled(cmds) || target.input.disableByParent;

                                                std.foldl(
                                                    function(acc, rule)
                                                        if isDisabled then
                                                            acc
                                                        else if rule.typ == _rule.typ.fill.key || rule.typ == _rule.typ.fillAllOptions.key then
                                                            if _calc.isSVF(target) then
                                                                _calc.combineSingleFillRule(target, acc, rule)

                                                            else if _calc.isMVF(target) then
                                                                _calc.combineMultipleValueFillRule(target, acc, rule)

                                                            else if _utils.isWidgetType(target, [_widgetKey.Repeatable]) then
                                                                _calc.combineRepeatableFillRule(target, acc, rule)

                                                            else
                                                                acc
                                                        else
                                                            acc
                                                    , rules
                                                    , cmds
                                                )
                                        )
                                        .andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectC(target))
                                        .andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectD(target, queryExcludedOptions))
                                        .andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectE(target, queryAssociatedOptions))
                                        .andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectF1(target))
                                        .andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectF2(target, queryExcludedOptions, queryAssociatedOptions))
                                        .andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectV(target))
                                        .andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectH(target, queryExcludedOptions))
                                        .andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectI1(target))
                                        .andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectK(target))
                                        .andThen(
                                            function(cmds)
                                                std.foldl(
                                                    function(acc, rule)
                                                        if rule.typ == _rule.typ.autoCorrect.key then
                                                            _calc.combineAutoCorrectRule(target, acc, rule)
                                                        else
                                                            acc
                                                    , rules
                                                    , cmds
                                                )
                                        )
                            )

                );

            res { commands: commands }
        ,

        getSyncKeyRules: function(fakeTarget, fakeTargetCmds, rawRules)
            local isParentDeactivated = _calc.getDisabled(fakeTargetCmds);
            local isParentHidden = _calc.getHidden(fakeTargetCmds);

            local encodedDisabledOptions = _calc.getDisabledOptions(fakeTargetCmds);
            local encodedSelectedOptions = _calc.getSelectedOptions(fakeTarget, fakeTargetCmds);
            local encodedDeactivatedOptions = _utils.purge(encodedDisabledOptions, encodedSelectedOptions);
            local encodedDisabledSelectedOptions = _utils.intersect(encodedSelectedOptions, encodedDisabledOptions);
            local encodedEnabledSelectedOptions = _utils.purge(encodedSelectedOptions, encodedDisabledOptions);
            local encodedDeselectedOptions = _utils.purge(fakeTarget.input.value, encodedSelectedOptions);

            local keyFillRules = std.foldl(
                function(acc, rawRule)
                    std.foldl(
                        function(acc, key)
                            local keyRules = _utils.get(acc, [key], []);
                            local rule = rawRule { value: rawRule.value[key] };

                            acc { [key]: keyRules + [rule] }
                        , std.objectFields(rawRule.value)
                        , acc
                    )
                , _utils.getRulesByType([_rule.typ.fill.key], rawRules)
                , {}
            );

            std.foldl(
                function(res, key)
                    local target = fakeTarget.targets[key];
                    local isMVF = _calc.isMVF(target);
                    local getFieldOptions = _fakeCheckboxUtils.getFieldOptions(fakeTarget, key);
                    local includeField = _fakeCheckboxUtils.includeField(fakeTarget, key);

                    local parentRules = [
                        _calcRule.hide(isParentHidden),
                        _calcRule.unsafeSetValue("touched", false),
                    ];

                    local rules =
                        if isMVF then
                            local selectedOptions = getFieldOptions(encodedSelectedOptions);
                            local disabledSelectedOptions = getFieldOptions(encodedDisabledSelectedOptions);
                            local enabledSelectedOptions = getFieldOptions(encodedEnabledSelectedOptions);
                            local deactivatedOptions = getFieldOptions(encodedDeactivatedOptions);
                            local deselectedOptions = getFieldOptions(encodedDeselectedOptions);

                            [
                                _calcRule.unsafeSetValue("value", selectedOptions),
                                _calcRule.fill(disabledSelectedOptions, disabled=true),
                                _calcRule.addDeactivatedOptions(deactivatedOptions),
                                _calcRule.deactivate(isParentDeactivated),
                            ]
                        else
                            local isDeactivated = includeField(encodedDeactivatedOptions);
                            local isSelected = includeField(encodedSelectedOptions);
                            local isDeselected = includeField(encodedDeselectedOptions);
                            local isDisabledFill = includeField(encodedDisabledSelectedOptions);

                            local fillCmds = std.map(
                                function(rule)
                                    rule { condition: rule.condition && isSelected, disabled: rule.disabled && isDisabledFill }
                                , _utils.get(keyFillRules, [key], [])
                            );

                            fillCmds
                            + [
                                _calcRule.deactivate(isParentDeactivated || isDeactivated),
                                _calcRule.unsafeSetValue("value", _const.DefaultJsonValue, isDeselected),
                            ];

                    res { [key]: parentRules + rules }
                , fakeTarget.keys
                , {}
            ),

        combineFakeCheckboxRules: function(fakeTarget, rawRules, rawKeyRules, formStates, debug)
            local syncTouchedRule = _calcRule.unsafeSetValue("touched", fakeTarget.input.touched);
            local fakeCheckboxRules = _fakeCheckboxUtils.classifyRules(fakeTarget, rawKeyRules);
            local parentRules =
                _fakeCheckboxUtils.getEncodedRules(fakeTarget, rawRules)
                + fakeCheckboxRules.parentRules
                + [syncTouchedRule];

            local isValidArguments =
                _validate.onRules(fakeTarget, parentRules, formStates)
                && _validate.onApplicableWidgets(fakeTarget, parentRules)
                && _validate.onKeysRules(rawKeyRules);

            local fakeTargetRes =
                if isValidArguments then _calc.toGaiaCommand(fakeTarget, parentRules, _formState.formStates) else null;
            local fakeTargetCmds = fakeTargetRes.commands;

            local syncRules = _calc.getSyncKeyRules(fakeTarget, fakeTargetCmds, rawRules);

            local allKeyRules = std.foldl(
                function(res, sync)
                    res { [sync.key]: sync.rules + res[sync.key] }
                , fakeCheckboxRules.keyRules
                , syncRules
            );

            local keyTargetsRes = std.foldl(
                function(res, key)
                    local rules = allKeyRules[key];
                    local target = fakeTarget.targets[key];

                    res { [key]: _calc.init(target.input { touched: fakeTarget.input.touched }, target.output, rules, formStates) }
                , fakeTarget.keys
                , {}
            );

            local keyTargetsCmds = std.foldl(
                function(res, key)
                    res { [key]: keyTargetsRes[key].commands }
                , fakeTarget.keys
                , {}
            );

            local parentCommands = fakeTargetCmds.andThen(_calc.combineSideEffectI2(fakeTarget, keyTargetsCmds));
            local parentRes = fakeTargetRes { commands: parentCommands };

            if debug then
                { fakeTarget: parentRes, targets: keyTargetsRes }
            else
                std.flatMap(function(key) keyTargetsRes[key].gaiaEvents, fakeTarget.keys)
                + parentRes.gaiaEvents,

        init: function(ctx, output, rules, formStates)
            local targetObj = _utils.getTargetObject(ctx, output);
            local isValidArguments =
                _validate.onRules(targetObj, rules, formStates)
                && _validate.onApplicableWidgets(targetObj, rules);

            if !isValidArguments then
                {}

            else
                _calc.toGaiaCommand(targetObj, rules, formStates),
    },

    fakeCheckbox: {
        local ref = self,

        targetObj: {
            input: null,
            output: null,
            targets: {},
            keys: [],
        },

        utils: {
            classifyRules: function(fakeTarget, rawKeyRules)
                std.foldl(
                    function(acc, obj)
                        local target = fakeTarget.targets[obj.key];
                        local partition = _utils.partition(obj.rules, function(rule) _calc.isMVF(target) && std.member(_rule.getOptionControlRules, rule.typ));
                        local res = _calc.toGaiaCommand(target, partition.white, _formState.formStates);
                        local ops = _calc.getDisabledOptions(res.commands);
                        local encodedOptions = std.map(function(op) _fakeCheckboxUtils.encodeOption(obj.key, op), ops);

                        acc {
                            keyRules: acc.keyRules + [obj { rules: partition.black }],
                            parentRules: acc.parentRules + [_calcRule.addDeactivatedOptions(encodedOptions)],
                        }
                    , rawKeyRules
                    , { keyRules: [], parentRules: [] }
                ),

            getEncodedRules: function(fakeCheckbox, rules)
                local getEncodedOptions(options) = _fakeCheckboxUtils.getEncodedRuleOptions(fakeCheckbox, options);
                local getEncodedOptionGroups(options) = std.map(function(option) _fakeCheckboxUtils.getEncodedRuleOptions(fakeCheckbox, [option]), options);
                local multipleValueKeys = _fakeCheckboxUtils.getMultipleValueKeys(fakeCheckbox);

                std.map(
                    function(rule)
                        if std.member(_rule.getKeyExcludeRules, rule.typ) then
                            rule

                        else if rule.typ == _rule.typ.fill.key then
                            rule { value: _fakeCheckboxUtils.getEncodedRuleValue(fakeCheckbox, rule.value) }

                        else if rule.typ == _rule.typ.fillAllOptions.key then
                            rule {
                                value: getEncodedOptions(fakeCheckbox.keys),
                                typ: _rule.typ.fill.key,
                            }

                        else if _rule.typ.excludeOptions.key == rule.typ then
                            rule {
                                optionGroups: getEncodedOptionGroups(rule.options),
                                typ: _rule.typ.excludeOptionGroups.key,
                            }
                        else if _rule.typ.associateOptions.key == rule.typ then
                            rule {
                                optionGroups: getEncodedOptionGroups(rule.options),
                                typ: _rule.typ.associateOptionGroups.key,
                            }

                        else if std.member(_rule.getRulesWithOptionGroups, rule.typ) then
                            rule { optionGroups: std.map(getEncodedOptions, rule.optionGroups) }

                        else if _rule.typ.excludeEachOptions.key == rule.typ then
                            rule {
                                optionGroups: getEncodedOptionGroups(fakeCheckbox.keys),
                                typ: _rule.typ.excludeOptionGroups.key,
                            }
                        else if _rule.typ.associateEachOptions.key == rule.typ then
                            rule {
                                optionGroups: getEncodedOptionGroups(multipleValueKeys),
                                typ: _rule.typ.associateOptionGroups.key,
                            }
                        else if _rule.typ.associateOtherOptions.key == rule.typ then
                            rule {
                                optionGroups: [getEncodedOptions(rule.options), getEncodedOptions(_utils.purge(multipleValueKeys, rule.options))],
                                typ: _rule.typ.associateOptionGroups.key,
                            }

                        else if std.member(_rule.getRulesWithOptions, rule.typ) then
                            rule { options: getEncodedOptions(rule.options) }
                        else
                            rule
                    , rules
                ),

            /**** Return option IDs for a given FakeCheckbox key.
                * @param key - Ex: key = "key1"
                * @param encodedOptions - Ex: encodedOptions = ["key1#option1", "key2#option2"]
                * @returns {string[]} - Ex: ["option1"]
                */
            getFieldOptions: function(fakeTarget, key) function(encodedOptions)
                local decodedOptions = std.map(_fakeCheckboxUtils.decodeOption(fakeTarget), encodedOptions);

                local keyOptions = std.filter(
                    function(decodedOption)
                        decodedOption.fakeCheckboxKey == key && decodedOption.isOption
                    , decodedOptions
                );

                std.map(function(decodedOption) decodedOption.optionId, keyOptions),

            includeField: function(fakeTarget, key) function(encodedOptions)
                local decodedOptions = std.map(_fakeCheckboxUtils.decodeOption(fakeTarget), encodedOptions);

                std.filter(
                    function(decodedOption)
                        decodedOption.fakeCheckboxKey == key && !decodedOption.isOption
                    , decodedOptions
                ) != [],

            encodeOption: function(fakeCheckboxKey, optionId=null)
                local optionPart = if optionId != null then [optionId] else [];

                std.join("#", [fakeCheckboxKey] + optionPart),

            /**** Decode an encoded string for extracting FakeCheckbox key and option if any.
                * @param fakeTarget
                * @param encodedString - Ex: "key#option1"
                * @returns {object} - Ex: { fakeCheckboxKey: "key", isOption: true, optionId: "option1" }
                */
            decodeOption: function(fakeTarget) function(encodedString)
                local parts = std.splitLimit(encodedString, "#", 1);
                local targetKey = if std.length(parts) > 0 then parts[0] else "";
                local targetOptions = _calc.getAllOptions(fakeTarget.targets[targetKey]);
                local targetOption = encodedString[std.length(targetKey) + 1:std.length(encodedString)];

                if std.member(fakeTarget.keys, targetKey) then
                    if targetOption == "" then
                        {
                            fakeCheckboxKey: targetKey,
                            isOption: false,
                            optionId: null,
                        }
                    else
                        {
                            fakeCheckboxKey: targetKey,
                            isOption: true,
                            optionId: targetOption,
                        }
                else
                    error "Unable to decode FakeCheckbox option. Invalid key: " + targetKey + ". Valid keys are: " + std.toString(fakeTarget.keys),

            getMultipleValueKeys:: function(fakeTarget)
                std.filter(
                    function(key)
                        local target = fakeTarget.targets[key];

                        _calc.isMVF(target)
                    , fakeTarget.keys
                ),
            getWidgetEncodedOptions:: function(fakeTarget) function(keys)
                std.flatMap(
                    function(key)
                        local target = fakeTarget.targets[key];

                        if _calc.isMVF(target) then
                            local widgetOptions = _calc.getAllOptions(target);

                            std.map(
                                function(option)
                                    _fakeCheckboxUtils.encodeOption(key, option)
                                , widgetOptions
                            )
                        else
                            [_fakeCheckboxUtils.encodeOption(key)]
                    , keys
                ),
            getInputEncodedOptions:: function(fakeTarget, touchedKey)
                std.foldl(
                    function(res, key)
                        local target = fakeTarget.targets[key];
                        local selectedOptions =
                            if _utils.isEmpty(target.input.value) then
                                []
                            else if _calc.isMVF(target) then
                                std.map(
                                    function(option)
                                        _fakeCheckboxUtils.encodeOption(key, option)
                                    , target.input.value
                                )
                            else
                                [_fakeCheckboxUtils.encodeOption(key)];

                        if key == touchedKey then
                            res + selectedOptions
                        else
                            selectedOptions + res
                    , fakeTarget.keys
                    , []
                ),

            getEncodedRuleValue:: function(fakeTarget, ruleValue)
                if std.isObject(ruleValue) then
                    local valueKeys = std.objectFields(ruleValue);

                    std.flatMap(
                        function(key)
                            local target = fakeTarget.targets[key];
                            local value = ruleValue[key];

                            if !std.member(fakeTarget.keys, key) then
                                error "Invalid FakeCheckbox key: " + key + ". Valid keys are: " + std.toString(fakeTarget.keys)
                            else if _utils.isEmpty(value) then
                                []
                            else if _calc.isMVF(target) then
                                local widgetOptions = _calc.getAllOptions(target);
                                local options = _calc.refineConstant(target)(value);
                                local validOptions = _utils.intersect(options, widgetOptions);

                                std.map(
                                    function(option)
                                        _fakeCheckboxUtils.encodeOption(key, option)
                                    , validOptions
                                )
                            else
                                [_fakeCheckboxUtils.encodeOption(key)]
                        , valueKeys
                    )
                else
                    error "Invalid FakeCheckbox's value. Received: " + std.toString(ruleValue),

            getEncodedRuleOptions:: function(fakeTarget, ruleOptions)
                std.flatMap(
                    function(key)
                        local target = fakeTarget.targets[key];

                        if !std.member(fakeTarget.keys, key) then
                            error "Invalid FakeCheckbox key: " + key + ". Valid keys are: " + std.toString(fakeTarget.keys)
                        else if _calc.isMVF(target) then
                            local widgetOptions = _calc.getAllOptions(target);

                            std.map(
                                function(option)
                                    _fakeCheckboxUtils.encodeOption(key, option)
                                , widgetOptions
                            )
                        else
                            [_fakeCheckboxUtils.encodeOption(key)]
                    , if ruleOptions == _const.AllWidgetOptions then fakeTarget.keys else ruleOptions
                ),

        },

                , false

                    res || target.input.autoFilled

                , false
            );

                    disable: fakeInput.disable,

                uiSchema: { "ui:widget": _widgetKey.FakeMultipleCheckbox },

                fakeInput: fakeInput,
                toggle: toggleInfo,
            },
    },
